create_edge_degree_embedding: create an EdgeDegreeEmbedding module with sphere channels, lmax, mmax, and a radial MLP for edge features
run_edge_degree_forward: run the EdgeDegreeEmbedding forward pass with node features, edge features, edge index, and wigner inverse envelope
create_chg_spin_embedding: create a ChgSpinEmbedding module with pos_emb, lin_emb, or rand_emb type for charge or spin embedding
run_chg_spin_forward: run the ChgSpinEmbedding forward pass to embed charge or spin values into a fixed-size vector
create_dataset_embedding: create a DatasetEmbedding module with a dataset mapping dict and optional gradient enablement for per-dataset embeddings
